Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Sr. No. Description & Specification Quantity 1. Supply of Nitrile Insulation sheet 25 mm thick, class 0 complete with adhesiv 60 square m e, nitrile tape etc. suitable for insulating the 500 TR chillers as per scope of eter work attached as annexure A 2. Removal of old insulation and installation of new 25 mm thick nitrile insulatio 02 set n on Carrier Chillers 500 TR as per scope of work attached as annexure A Annexure – A Scope of Work Carrier Chillers (Quantity: 02 nos., Model: 19XRV5557387KGH52) of cooling capacity 500TR are operational in MT chilled water plant at SCL. The existing nitrile insulation installed over the cold surfaces of the chiller s is deteriorated and to be replaced with new 25 mm thick class ‘0’ insulation. The scope of work covers th e removal of the existing insulation and re-insulating the entire cold surfaces of the chillers. The detailed sc ope of work is as under: 1. The insulation shall be closed cell nitrile rubber of minimum thickness 25 mm and class ‘0’ rating. 2. The scope covers the insulation complete with adhesive chemical, nitrile tapes, consumables etc. require d for installation of the nitrile insulation. 3. The scope includes removal of old nitrile insulation from the chiller surface and making it good for installation of new nitrile insulation. 4. All the insulation joints shall be properly sealed with adhesive and covered with 50 mm wide nitrile tape. 5. The scrap insulation after dismantling the existing insulation to be shifted to the scrap yard approx. 500 m away within the SCL premises. 6. List of approved makes: Armaflex/Trocellen/Paramount-XPE/Armacell/Supreme/Aeroflex. 7. Completion Period: The entire work shall be completed within the 8 weeks from the date of clearance g iven by SCL. .
